scripts.dev: npm run build -w @orbit/shared && concurrently -k -n server,desktop "npm run dev -w @orbit/server" "npm run dev -w @orbit/desktop"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @orbit/shared && npm run build -w @orbit/server && npm run build -w @orbit/desktop
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @orbit/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test
scripts.build:mac: npm run validate:release -w @orbit/desktop && npm run build && npm run package:mac -w @orbit/desktop
scripts.build:mac:arm64: npm run validate:release -w @orbit/desktop && npm run build && npm run package:mac:arm64 -w @orbit/desktop
scripts.build:mac:x64: npm run validate:release -w @orbit/desktop && npm run build && npm run package:mac:x64 -w @orbit/desktop
scripts.build:mac:universal: npm run validate:release -w @orbit/desktop && npm run build && npm run package:mac:universal -w @orbit/desktop
scripts.build:win: npm run validate:release -w @orbit/desktop && npm run build && npm run package:win -w @orbit/desktop
scripts.format: prettier --write apps packages scripts docs README.md *.json *.ts *.js *.yml .github/workflows/*.yml
